subscription.title: Sign in to Claude
subscription.description:
1. [Open the Claude sign-in page]({auth_url}) and approve access.
2. Claude shows an authentication code (it looks like `abc…#xyz…`).
3. Paste the whole code below.

This creates a separate login just for Home Assistant, so it does not interfere with Claude Code on your computer.

admin_api.title: Anthropic Admin API
admin_api.description: Create an Admin API key (starts with `sk-ant-admin`) at platform.claude.com → Settings → Admin keys. Only organisation admins can create one.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description: The stored Claude credentials no longer work. Continue to sign in again.

error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed. Check the code or key and try again (each sign-in code can only be used once; the link has been renewed).
error.invalid_code: No code found in what you pasted.
error.state_mismatch: That code belongs to a different sign-in attempt. Use the link shown on this page.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Anthropic. Try again later.
error.rate_limited: Anthropic is rate limiting sign-in requests. Wait a few minutes, then use the (renewed) sign-in link again.

data_description.scan_interval: The subscription endpoint is rate limited; do not go below 120 s.
